landmarks.name: Shin-Okubo Station
landmarks.fact: Shin-Okubo Station on the Yamanote Line is located at the heart of Tokyo's vibrant Koreatown district.

landmarks.name: Hotel Gracery Shinjuku
landmarks.fact: Hotel Gracery Shinjuku is famous for its iconic, life-sized Godzilla head perched on the eighth-floor terrace.

landmarks.name: Shinjuku Station
landmarks.fact: Shinjuku Station is world-renowned as the busiest railway station, handling over three million passengers daily.

landmarks.name: Sekaido Shinjuku Main Store
landmarks.fact: Sekaido Shinjuku is one of Tokyo's most famous and extensive art and drafting supply stores.

landmarks.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
landmarks.fact: Shinjuku Gyoen is a expansive historic park featuring Japanese landscape, French Formal, and English Landscape gardens.

landmarks.name: Sendagaya Station
landmarks.fact: Sendagaya Station provides direct access to the Japan National Stadium and Meiji Jingu Gaien park grounds.

landmarks.name: Takashimaya Times Square
landmarks.fact: Takashimaya Times Square is a major retail complex housing a flagship department store, specialty shops, and restaurants.

landmarks.name: Isetan Shinjuku Department Store
landmarks.fact: Isetan Shinjuku is a historic department store celebrated for its flagship luxury fashion offerings and gourmet food hall.

landmarks.name: Kinokuniya Shinjuku Main Store
landmarks.fact: Kinokuniya Shinjuku Main Store is an iconic multi-story bookstore offering extensive Japanese and international publications.

landmarks.name: Shinjuku Toho Building
landmarks.fact: The Shinjuku Toho Building in Kabukicho is a premier entertainment hub featuring cinemas, restaurants, and a hotel.
